params.message:
Trends: approve or reject, approval and the site apart, sectors, unwritten

- Approve and Reject replace "We stand behind this" and "Not like this".
- Changing the text has one button, Save; approving is its own move.
- A trend page shows its approval, its place on gentells.com and the
  posts about it as three separate lines.
- The Trends tab gains a count by sector (on gentells.com, no post yet,
  waiting, rejected, posts) and a list of rejected trends.
- Both trend lists filter on whether a post is about them.
- Write lists the approved trends no post is about yet, in the opening
  and under See all.

Portal: In de Studio keur je trends goed of af, zie je per sector hoeveel trends en posts er zijn, en toont Write welke goedgekeurde trends nog geen post hebben.
